heading: FAQ’s on Social Media App Development Solutions

items.question: Can the app be customised?
items.answer: Yes. Features, branding and community rules can be tailored to your concept.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation and extra features.

items.question: Does it include moderation tools?
items.answer: Yes. Reporting, moderation queues and admin controls are included.

items.question: Can the app scale as users grow?
items.answer: Yes. The backend and database are built to scale with your community.

items.question: Can I monetise the platform?
items.answer: Yes. Ads, subscriptions, tips and paid content can be supported.

items.question: How much does a social media app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and platforms. Share your requirements for an estimate.
